about_the_game:
A Game About Making Mosaics is a peaceful sandbox where creativity flows at your own pace. Craft colorful tiles, break them apart, and place them piece by piece to create your own mosaics. From tiny experiments to large, detailed artworks.
There are no goals, timers, or pressure. Just you, a blank canvas, and endless possibilities.


Each session begins with a blank space and a simple set of tools. Choose your canvas size, pick a palette that suits your mood, and start crafting.
When you’re ready to rest, take a photo of your finished piece. Your creations are saved in your Gallery, where you can revisit them later, make adjustments, or download them as PNGs to share with others.

A Small Game About Big Creativity

A Game About Making Mosaics celebrates the joy of slow, mindful creation. It’s not about winning or completing tasks, it’s about the simple satisfaction of placing one tile after another and seeing something beautiful emerge.
The game’s minimalist art direction uses clean shapes, plain colors, and irregular outlines to evoke a sense of warmth and imperfection, much like real handmade mosaics. Combined with soft ambient music and gentle sound effects, the experience becomes meditative and cozy.

Features

  • Creative Freedom – Build mosaics of any size and style.

  • Custom Palettes – Select or modify colors for both your tiles and background to match your creative vision.

  • Save & Share – Capture your finished mosaics, revisit them in the Gallery, or export them as PNGs.

  • Relaxing Atmosphere – Minimalist visuals, soothing sounds, and calm music for a cozy creative flow.

  • Simple, Intuitive Tools – Easy to pick up, perfect for players who want to relax and express themselves.

Take your time. Break some tiles. Try new colors. Make something just because it feels good.
A Game About Making Mosaics is your small, quiet space to slow down and create.
